summary: Backend regression for camera upload, quoted+photo billing visibility, owner transaction coverage, and 14-day idle auto-cancel passed. Frontend mobile checks passed for kurir request-date/detail click, customer Bayar pay-now/no-Setujui-Nota, and owner laporan detail open; camera modal trigger from Timbang remains unresolved in web automation.

ui_bugs.issue: After opening Timbang from kurir, [data-testid='photo-camera'] was not present in DOM across 3 retries, so CameraCapture modal (capture/permission/error states) could not be validated end-to-end from UI.

integration_issues.flow: Pegawai Kurir -> Timbang Pakaian & Foto -> CameraCapture
integration_issues.issue: Backend upload endpoint works and weighed orders can persist photos, but UI entry point to open camera modal was not reliably available in automation run.

action_items: Main agent: investigate why photo action button is missing/unavailable on Timbang web screen despite implementation in /app/frontend/app/timbang/[id].tsx.
Main agent: after fixing Timbang photo entry rendering, retest camera modal states (capture button / permission CTA / mount error message) on web preview.
Keep monitoring only non-blocking Expo warning: shadow* deprecated -> boxShadow migration.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/api.ts and frontend/src/photos.ts use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL only; if deployment contract requires EXPO_BACKEND_URL, support both explicitly to avoid env regressions.
CameraCapture has informative permission/mount error states implemented, but current UI render path prevented access to those controls in this run.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (kurir date/detail + customer bayar + owner laporan pass; camera UI entry unresolved)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_iter15 UI orders for seeded customer Pelanggan Demo via /app/tests/iter15_ui_data_setup.py and removed with /app/tests/iter15_ui_data_cleanup.py. No TEST_iter15 customers retained.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not repeat camera selector rewrites immediately: 3 attempts already done for photo-camera/camera modal. Focus on why photo section/button is not rendered/available on Timbang in web preview first.
rca_of_issue: RCA (current evidence): Backend order+photo persistence is healthy (/api/upload and weigh with photos pass). Kurir->Timbang navigation works and request-date/detail interactions pass. However, camera entry UI on Timbang could not be reached because [data-testid='photo-camera'] was absent during automated runs (including one run stuck on Timbang loading state). This points to a frontend rendering/state path issue on Timbang screen rather than backend upload logic.
